We do not have definitive evidence that this
model could meaningfully help a novice to create severe biological harm, our defined threshold
for High capability, and the model remains on the cusp of being able to reach this capability.

findings.text: Safe-completions replace binary refusals and improved safety on dual-use prompts while increasing helpfulness versus refusal-trained o3.

source.quote:
As an alternative, we introduced safe-
completions: a safety-training approach that centers on the safety of the assistant’s output rather
than a binary classification of the user’s intent.
